name: nonApi_postKennelReminders
description: Weekly reminder in each kennel's private Mismanagement chat (E9.F1.S33, from BT-15). Posts Monday 09:00 London (London hour checked here; the API timer runs hourly on Mondays) one message per kennel with something waiting — today: photos to review (HC.KennelPhotos Status 1: count and oldest) — from the Harrier Central system hasher, MessageType 100. Only kennels with at least one Mismanagement member. The message id is a GUID derived from (kennel, ISO week), so a rerun the same week finds it and posts nothing. Called by the API timer only; not reachable from a client (nonApi_).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: 1 = post now whatever the day and hour (tests). Default 0.

parameters.name: onlyKennelId
parameters.description: One kennel only (tests). NULL = every kennel due.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: 1 = return what would be posted (AlreadyPosted says if it already is) and write nothing.

rowsets.name: Reminders
rowsets.description: One row per kennel due this week, ordered by KennelShortName; empty outside Monday 09:xx London unless @force.

columns.name: MessageId
columns.description: The week's send id for the kennel.

columns.name: AlreadyPosted
columns.description: 1 = this week's reminder already existed: the caller must NOT push it again.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.EventMessage (MessageType 100, sender Harrier Central a7c0e6f2-5b1d-4c8e-9f3a-0d2b6e4c1a01) per kennel not yet posted this week, one transaction per kennel, existence checked WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog one summary row per run (StrParam1 = ISO week)
THROWs after logging to HC.ErrorLog on any error (and when the Harrier Central hasher is missing)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
